method: FULL sha256 of all five prefilter candidates, then hardlink within confirmed groups. Nothing deleted.

falsified_group.note: The 3x16 MiB head/mid/tail prefilter matched these three, but their FULL sha256 values differ, so they were never grouped and never touched. The differing bytes lie outside the sampled windows.

correction: sr5's earlier lead said 'if a full hash confirms them, hardlinking frees 10.233 GiB'. That was an UPPER BOUND on an unconfirmed prefilter. The measured answer is 3.411 GiB -- one of the two candidate groups was a false positive. A sampled prefilter may choose what to hash; it may never decide that two files are equal.
caution: The two linked paths now share one inode; any regeneration must write to a fresh path, never in place.
